description: This PHP source file handles download of parental reports in a web application. It initializes security measures, verifies user login, manages file download with support for range requests, and processes form input to determine which report file to serve.

classes.name: csrfprotector_rdkb
classes.description: A class providing CSRF protection mechanisms, specifically the init() method invoked to initialize security.

methods.name: file_download
methods.description: Handles the process of sending a specified file to the client with support for Range headers, proper headers, and chunked transfer.
